leadText: Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia (Japanese: Doctor Okido's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia) is a segment featured at the end of episodes in Japan. Featured from DP001 to DP097, it was preceded by Pokémon Trivia Quiz and succeeded by Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Examination.
plainText:
Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia (Japanese: Doctor Okido's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia) is a segment featured at the end of episodes in Japan. Featured from DP001 to DP097, it was preceded by Pokémon Trivia Quiz and succeeded by Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Examination.
 

==List of Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia segments==
 

==Trivia==
The senryū for DP094 is a reference to the Japanese song Fuyu no uta. 

==Related articles==
